# dsh-miliastra v0.6.1

**安装**：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.6.1` → 重启 `dsh web`
**Install**: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.6.1`, then restart `dsh web`.

[中文](#cn-v0.6.1) | [English](#en-v0.6.1)

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.1">✨ 新增功能</h3>

- **面板第六个 tab「网格计算」**：真机 UGC 画布是 **1600 × 1000**，所有坐标都按它设计 —— 这一页把画布按 **X / Y 两个步长**切格子，
  给**人和玩家**算坐标（摆放模型时对位置）。**纯前端计算**：一个工具都不调、不写任何文件、不碰活文件。 @LoktLin
  - 左栏：画布宽高 / X 步长 / Y 步长（默认 1600×1000、**X 100 / Y 50**）+ 四个预设 + 结论 + 「像素 → 格」「格 → 像素」双向换算 + 一键复制
  - 右栏：**可点的网格图** + 逐格速查表；点任一格 ⇒ **吸附到该格中心并选中**（左右两张卡同步）
- **每格灰色坐标**：`中心像素 x,y`（默认）/ `格号 col,row` / `不显示` 三档。字号按格子的实际大小算，
  **塞不进就不画**并说明原因（画出来是糊的等于骗人）。 @LoktLin
- **选中 + 复制**：选中那格粉块高亮、标签变亮粉加粗，图下一行写清「格号 / 覆盖范围 / 左上 / 中心」，
  旁边就是**「复制选中的格」**——直接粘给玩家或记进备注。 @LoktLin

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.1-improve">🎨 体验优化</h3>

- **面板按钮条改成六等分**（初级功能 / 高级功能 / 模拟器 / 预制效果 / 像素画 / **网格计算**）。
- **步长除不尽不再被拒**：旧规则是"不整除就直接拒绝建档"；现在**如实报「残 N px」并把界外那一条丢掉** ——
  网格只覆盖 `cols*stepX × rows*stepY`，落在残格/画布外的点**不算**。
  例子：`1600×1000 / X110 Y80` ⇒ X `14.5455` 残 60px、Y `12.5000` 残 40px ⇒ **14 × 12 = 168 格**，有效覆盖 `x[0,1540) y[0,960)`。 @LoktLin
- **X / Y 步长可以不同**（旧技能只有一个正方形 `cell`）；推荐值 **X 100 / Y 50**。
- **防呆一律显式说明、不静默**：步长 1px（160 万格）时**不画格线**、**不建速查表**；格太多（>600）或字太小（<14）时**不画格内坐标** —— 数字照给，原因写清。
- `tools/dump-panel-text.mjs` 支持 **`--tab <页>`**（改面板文案时先以使用者视角读一遍那一页）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.1-bug">🐛 问题修复</h3>

- **格内坐标字号会顶破"塞得进本格"的上限**：四舍五入（23.684 → 23.7）会超出按格宽算出的上限 ⇒ 改为**向下取整到 0.1**。 @LoktLin
- **`package-lock.json` 的根包版本又漂了**（自 0.5.1 起没跟 `package.json` 同步，0.6.0 时就已不同步）⇒ 一并修正到 0.6.1。 @LoktLin
- **CHANGELOG 漏写 0.6.0 一节**（发版时漏了）⇒ 按 `.github/release-notes/v0.6.0.md` 回填。

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.1-chores">⚠️ 其他变更</h3>

- **只改了 `lib/client.js` 一侧** ⇒ 装完/拉源码后**刷新页面（F5）**就能看到；Host 半边一个字没动、**不用重启 `dsh web`**。
- **界面未做视觉验证**（开发机没有浏览器）：结构、字号算式、标签数、选中态与按钮禁用态都由**真 React 静态渲染**的回归钉住（`client-render-test` **49 → 60** 条断言），
  但"字够不够看清、点着顺不顺手"仍需人眼过一遍。
- **坐标口径**：本页 = **设计画布**（左上 (0,0)、x 右增、**y 下增**）；模拟器内部舞台那套「左下原点」是另一层，有一条反向绊线钉住两者不许混用。
- **工作区里那套同规则的小工具暂未跟着改**（开发机没有 Python，改完无法验证）—— 它的旧规则已在其文档顶部标注。

<h3 id="en-v0.6.1">✨ New Features</h3>

- **Sixth panel tab, "Grid Calculator"**: the device UGC canvas is **1600 × 1000** and every coordinate is designed against it —
  this page slices the canvas by **separate X / Y steps** so humans and players can work out coordinates (useful when placing models).
  It is **pure front-end computation**: it calls no tool, writes no file, and never touches a live file. @LoktLin
  - Left column: canvas width/height, X step, Y step (default 1600×1000, **X 100 / Y 50**), four presets, the verdict,
    both conversion directions, and one-click copy
  - Right column: a **clickable grid** plus a per-cell lookup table; clicking a cell **snaps to that cell's centre and selects it** (both cards follow)
- **Per-cell grey coordinates**: `centre pixel x,y` (default) / `cell col,row` / `hidden`. The font size is derived from the actual cell size and
  the labels are **skipped with a stated reason** when they would not fit (an unreadable label is a lie). @LoktLin
- **Selection + copy**: the selected cell is highlighted and its label turns bright pink; the line under the grid spells out
  "cell / covered range / top-left / centre", with **"copy selected cell"** right next to it — paste it to a player or into your notes. @LoktLin

<h3 id="en-v0.6.1-improve">🎨 Improvements</h3>

- **The panel tab bar is now six columns** (Basic / Advanced / Simulator / Presets / Pixel art / **Grid calculator**).
- **A step that does not divide the canvas is no longer rejected**: the old rule refused to register such a grid at all; now the tool
  **reports the leftover pixels and drops that out-of-grid strip** — the grid covers
  `cols*stepX × rows*stepY` only, and points in the leftover strip or outside the canvas **do not count**.
  Example: `1600×1000 / X110 Y80` ⇒ X `14.5455` leaving 60 px, Y `12.5000` leaving 40 px ⇒ **14 × 12 = 168 cells**, covering `x[0,1540) y[0,960)`. @LoktLin
- **X and Y steps may differ** (the old helper had a single square `cell`); the recommended pair is **X 100 / Y 50**.
- **Guard rails always say why, never silently**: a 1 px step (1.6 M cells) draws **no grid lines** and builds **no lookup table**;
  too many cells (>600) or too small a font (<14) **skips the in-cell labels** — the numbers are still given, with the reason stated.
- `tools/dump-panel-text.mjs` accepts **`--tab <page>`** (read one page as a user would before touching its copy).

<h3 id="en-v0.6.1-bug">🐛 Bug Fixes</h3>

- **In-cell label font size could exceed the "fits the cell" cap**: rounding to one decimal (23.684 → 23.7) pushed it past the width-derived limit ⇒ now it is **floored to 0.1**. @LoktLin
- **`package-lock.json`'s root version drifted again** (unsynced since 0.5.1, already stale at 0.6.0) ⇒ corrected to 0.6.1. @LoktLin
- **The CHANGELOG was missing its 0.6.0 section** (missed during that release) ⇒ backfilled from `.github/release-notes/v0.6.0.md`.

<h3 id="en-v0.6.1-chores">⚠️ Chores</h3>

- **Only `lib/client.js` changed** ⇒ after installing or pulling, a **page refresh (F5)** is enough; the Host half is untouched and **`dsh web` need not restart**.
- **No visual verification** (the dev machine has no browser): structure, the font-size formula, label counts, selection state and disabled-button state are
  pinned by real React static-render regressions (`client-render-test`, **49 → 60** assertions), but whether the text is legible and the clicking feels right still needs a human eye.
- **Coordinate frame**: this page uses the **design canvas** (origin top-left, x right, **y down**); the simulator's internal stage
  ("origin bottom-left") is a different layer, and an inverted tripwire keeps the two from being mixed up.
- **The companion command-line helper for the same rules was left unchanged** (no Python on the dev machine, so a change could not be verified) —
  its old rule is flagged at the top of its document.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1
